put.description: Replaces the complete set of the guardians of the student (INV-32). The percentages add up to exactly 100.00, at most one link is the primary payer, at most one is the billing recipient, no guardian appears twice and every guardian is ACTIVE; an empty list leaves the student without guardians. A link that is absent or whose percentage, relationship or flags differ is closed today (the history stays) and a new one opens; an identical link is untouched, and a set that changes nothing changes nothing. The student must be ACTIVE. Needs the permission guardians:update.
